title: Quick Savory French White Beans Cassoulet
description: A cultured and snappy French dish featuring minced garlic and low-calorie-friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the dried white beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked beans, then set them aside.
In a large skillet, saute the minced garlic, onion, carrot, and celery in a little bit of oil until the vegetables are tender.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, chicken broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and drained white beans to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake the casserole for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
